offers.name: Record activity
offers.description: Other products send their activity-log entries here, so the website's staff see one history.

offers.name: Look up users
offers.description: Other products look up the website's users: one by id, staff who hold a permission, or a person by email or phone.

offers.name: Read roles
offers.description: Other products read the website's staff roles and what each may do.

offers.name: Read the signed-in person
offers.description: Other products read the profile of the person whose sign-in they were given.

offers.name: Read permissions
offers.description: Other products list this product's permissions, for the roles of the website's staff.

offers.name: Export a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product for everything it keeps about one person.

offers.name: Erase a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product to erase or anonymize one person's data.

features.name: Sign-in
features.description: Sign-in methods (one-time code or password by phone, password or code by email, and Google, Apple and Facebook), password rules and phone delivery channels.

features.name: Roles and permissions
features.description: One user list with roles: ready-made templates the merchant changes or deletes and the merchant's own, the role for new sign-ups, the permissions products supply plus the merchant's own names, session lengths per role, and the Users and Roles admin widgets.

features.name: Role requests
features.description: Visitors ask for a role (for example membership) with their name and phone number or email address; staff invite them with a setup link or decline.

features.name: Approval / invite sign-up
features.description: Sign-up rules: open sign-up, invite only or approval required, the required profile fields, and invites from the Users admin widget.

features.name: Two-step sign-in
features.description: A 6-digit authenticator-app code after the first step, with 10 recovery codes; optional, or required per role.

features.name: Consents
features.description: The merchant's consent list (terms, privacy policy, marketing …): sign-up and sign-in ask the required agreements again when their version changes; marketing consent stays apart, given or withdrawn by the user in My account; each answer is recorded on the user with its version and time.

features.name: Data rights
features.description: Download my data at once; Delete my account after the merchant approves (or after N days), erased in every product on the website through the Portal's links.

features.name: Import
features.description: Roles, custom fields, users (with their old password hashes), role requests and activity history moved in from another system with ss-import (server token only; no messages, events or alerts). Our admins switch it on for a migration and off after it.

features.name: Activity log copy
features.description: Keeps a copy of the activity log of every other product on the website.

permissions.name: Block, invite, approve and edit users (roles, notes)
